research:
SOURCES: ESPN summary API (DK pickcenter, injuries, predictor, opener boxes), Basketball-Reference 2025-26 team/player advanced pages, ESPN 2025-26 box-score logs (hit rates, own DvP calc), DAL/IND team notes, SportsGambler, Covers (Kalshi/ProphetX), Leans.ai, Pickswise, DocSports, Dimers, BettingPros, CBS Sports, Mavs Moneyball.
LINES: DK IND -6.5 (-110/-110; opened -5.5), total 237.5 (o-115/u-105; opened 234.5, was 238.5 this morning), ML IND -230 / DAL +190 (opened -205/+170). FanDuel IND -6.5; one book -6; MLs -199 to -230; totals 235.5-238.5. Novig IND 67c. ESPN predictor IND 67.2%.
TOTALS (NBA.md, BBR 2025-26): possessions avg(101.7 DAL, 101.0 IND)=101.35. DAL = avg(111.2 ORtg, 118.8 IND DRtg) x 1.0135 = 116.6; IND = avg(110.9, 116.5 DAL DRtg) x 1.0135 = 115.2. Projected 231.8 vs 237.5, 5.7 under, so the total is a leg. Model margin DAL +1.4 neutral, about IND +0.6 with home court, vs IND -6.5.
CAVEAT: IND's 2025-26 ratings (19-63) had no Haliburton (Achilles); he is back (23/12 in the opener) and IND scored 123 at NO, so the IND side of the model is the stalest number. Kyrie is also back for DAL.
INJURIES (ESPN Oct 23): DAL out Lively (foot), Aldama (knee), C. Martin (thumb), Biberovic (heel); Jett Howard day-to-day (calf). IND out McConnell (hamstring), Furphy (ACL); Nesmith (hamstring) and Sheppard (knee) day-to-day. Haliburton makes his home return (CBS).
OPENERS (ESPN box): IND won 123-120 at NO: Siakam 30/8 on 13-23, Haliburton 23/12 ast, Nembhard 18/9 ast, Toppin 20 off the bench, Zubac 16/15. DAL lost 128-110 at HOU: Flagg 32/5 on 10-17, Sasser 17, Marshall 16/6 ast, Kyrie 15 in 24 min, Gafford 2/3 in 22 min.
USAGE (BBR 2025-26): Siakam 30.1%, Flagg 26.9%, Toppin 24.8% (24 g), Nembhard 23.6%, Marshall 20.5%, Washington 20.1%, Zubac 19.2%. Haliburton (missed 2025-26) and Kyrie (ACL) have no 2025-26 usage; both will cut into Siakam's and Flagg's shots.
DvP (own FanDuel calc, ESPN 2025-26 boxes; rank 1 = most allowed): DAL G 11th, F 3rd, C 3rd; IND G 4th, F 14th, C 16th. Siakam and Toppin pass the gate; Flagg does not.
HIT RATES (ESPN 2025-26 logs): Siakam 24.0 ppg, 24+ 56.5% (62 g); Flagg 21.0 ppg (sd 9.6), 25+ 30% (70 g); Zubac 10.6 rpg, 10+ 58%. The 93% floors (Siakam about 14+) are not offered by any book, so main lines are used.
PROPS FOUND (priced): Siakam o23.5 -114 (SportsGambler; covered in 4 straight); Flagg 24.5: Kalshi over about 52c, ProphetX under about 53% (Covers). Leans.ai picks Flagg o24.5; BettingPros' undated consensus is 21.5. No Haliburton assists price found.
SGP: Siakam o23.5 (-114) + Flagg u24.5 (-113) = +254 by leg product (implied 0.283). Raw 0.51 x 0.53 = 0.27, with a small lift if IND controls the game: 0.275. No edge, not highlighted. Siakam's over also cuts against the Under we like (lesson 10/22), so it stays out of the straights.
EXPERTS: Pickswise DAL +6.5 (DAL bench 46-32 in the opener); DocSports DAL +6.5; SportsGambler IND -6.5 (51.3%); Dimers IND ML, 80.4%, 120-110; Leans.ai Flagg o24.5. Split on the spread; no Under picks found.
COACHING: DAL (now coached by Dusty May, per Mavs Moneyball) ran 101.7 pace last season with a 30th-ranked paint defense (Fox, team notes); IND plays fast (101.0) and now runs through Haliburton again. DAL is thin up front without Lively and Aldama, so Zubac and Siakam have a size edge.
